reason: The creativity gloss only restates the headword as the ability to create, without explaining originality or the production of new ideas or forms.
The forgetfulness gloss only restates the headword as a tendency to forget without explaining failures of memory or recall.
The trust/reliance gloss requires certainty based on past experience, although reliance can involve uncertainty and need not be based on prior experience; it overstates confidence as certainty.
The definition only restates the headword as unsure without independently explaining the epistemic state.
The perception gloss only restates the headword as the process of perceiving, without explaining sensory awareness or interpretation.
The arrangement/agreement gloss only restates the headwords as the thing arranged or agreed to; it does not independently describe a plan, disposition, or mutually accepted understanding.

The unrestricted mathematical degree gloss gives a highest power without specifying degree in a variable versus total degree; for a multivariate term total degree sums exponents rather than taking the highest. See https://doc.cgal.org/4.5.2/Polynomial/index.html.

The monic-polynomial gloss omits the defining requirement that the leading coefficient is one, falsely equating monic with univariate. See https://eceweb.uwaterloo.ca/~dwharder/Algorithmic_thinking/Polynomial_arithmetic/.
The geometric vertex gloss calls any intersection of lines a vertex and gives no incidence with the edges of the relevant figure; it is too broad to distinguish a vertex from an arbitrary crossing.

The reference gloss conflates a word's meaning with the class of objects it denotes and does not distinguish the relation of referring from its referents. See https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/frege/.
The supernaturalism gloss makes forces beyond ordinary understanding sufficient, conflating unexplained natural phenomena with belief in a supernatural realm or agency.
The axis gloss says only that a line satisfies certain unspecified conditions; without naming the conditions it fails to distinguish an axis from other lines through a figure.

The mean gloss leaves both functions unspecified, so it supplies no computable mathematical definition and would permit arbitrary quantities unrelated to a mean. See https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/eda/section3/eda351.htm.

The regression-line gloss treats an arbitrary smooth fitted curve as a line, conflating regression curves with the straight-line special case. See https://itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/pmd/section8/pmd8111.htm.

The psychotherapy gloss treats it exclusively as a branch of psychiatry, obscuring that psychological treatment is provided by several mental-health professions. See https://www.nimh.nih.gov/health/topics/psychotherapies.

The physical-science gloss lists properties, phenomena, and laws rather than describing a discipline studying the material world; it confuses the subject matter with the science. See https://ncses.nsf.gov/surveys/federal-funds-research-development/2021.

The historical psychology gloss limits the discipline to mental life, omitting its study of behavior and its biological, social, and environmental contexts. See https://www.apa.org/ed/precollege/topss/science/overview.
